requirements.title: Unit 3 Bathroom Fixture and Spatial Layout

patches.decision_note: Unit 3 bathroom-door position and clearance can change independently of fixture placement, shower location, and bathroom dimensions; drainage remains under the existing drainage Requirement.
The source explicitly enlarges the No1 bathroom, not the Unit 3 bathroom, and the applicable change is already represented under the Unit 1 common-bathroom Requirement.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text: İçeriye açıldığında kapı lavaboya çarptığı ve yalnızca 82 cmlik alan kaldığı için, kapının mevcut yönünü koruyup hole açılmasını öneriyoruz.

execution.observed_behavior: A dimensional layout check found that the client-selected inward-opening door hits the sink and leaves only 82 cm of space.

patches.decision_note: This is the first concrete dimensional failure after the client selected the inward-opening configuration; the separate AMBIGUOUS Event records the unresolved design decision.

The Unit 1 door sequence is target-specific at the unit level, but the supplied text does not safely establish whether every reference concerns the common bathroom or the ensuite; downstream requirement mapping may require adjudication.

The red-marked shower and subsequent fixture placements may be duplicated or misallocated between the Unit 1 common bathroom and ensuite; the image-dependent evidence does not safely identify which bathroom owns every fixture.
The routing evidence indicates a possible missed partition-wall construction change, but the raw source text needed to add and verify the Event is not supplied.
